item.title: Tateyama Snow Corridor (Yuki no Otani): Walk Between Towering Snow Walls — Guide
item.description: The Tateyama Snow Corridor, known in Japanese as Yuki no Otani, is created each spring when snow-clearing crews carve a road through drifts that can reach up to 20 metres deep near Murodo, on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route. The result is a walkway flanked by towering walls of snow, often well above head height even in early summer, that opens to visitors from mid-April and remains a striking sight through late June as the walls gradually melt down over the following weeks.
